statement:
∀ (a b : ℝ),
  a < b → IsOpen (Ioo a b) ∧ (IsClosed (Icc a b) ∧ ¬IsOpen (Icc a b)) ∧ ¬IsOpen (Ico a b) ∧ ¬IsClosed (Ico a b)
script:
# name: set-intervals-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.intervals_open_closed
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0', '2 * Real.pi', '(by positivity)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b), IsOpen (Ioo a b) ∧ (IsClosed (Icc a b) ∧ ¬ IsOpen (Icc a b)) ∧ (¬ IsOpen (Ico a b) ∧ ¬ IsClosed (Ico a b)) := by
  intro a b hab
  refine ⟨isOpen_Ioo, ⟨isClosed_Icc, fun h => ?_⟩, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (h.mem_nhds (left_mem_Icc.2 hab.le))
    have h2 := Icc_mem_nhds_iff.1 this
    simp at h2
  · have := h.mem_nhds (left_mem_Ico.2 hab)
    rw [mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at this
    obtain ⟨l, u, ⟨hl, hu⟩, hsub⟩ := this
    have := hsub (show (max l (a - 1) + a) / 2 ∈ Ioo l u from ⟨by
      cases max_cases l (a - 1) <;> linarith, by cases max_cases l (a - 1) <;> linarith⟩)
    have := this.1
    cases max_cases l (a - 1) <;> linarith
  · have hcl := h.closure_eq
    have hb : b ∈ closure (Ico a b) := by
      rw [closure_Ico hab.ne]; exact right_mem_Icc.2 hab.le
    rw [hcl] at hb
    exact lt_irrefl b hb.2
exact @key (0) (2 * Real.pi) ((by positivity))'),
    (['0', '1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b), IsOpen (Ioo a b) ∧ (IsClosed (Icc a b) ∧ ¬ IsOpen (Icc a b)) ∧ (¬ IsOpen (Ico a b) ∧ ¬ IsClosed (Ico a b)) := by
  intro a b hab

  · have := (h.mem_nhds (left_mem_Icc.2 hab.le))
    have h2 := Icc_mem_nhds_iff.1 this

    have := this.1

  · have hcl := h.closure_eq

    rw [hcl] at hb

exact @key (0) (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['-1', '1', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b), IsOpen (Ioo a b) ∧ (IsClosed (Icc a b) ∧ ¬ IsOpen (Icc a b)) ∧ (¬ IsOpen (Ico a b) ∧ ¬ IsClosed (Ico a b)) := by

    have h2 := Icc_mem_nhds_iff.1 this
    simp at h2
  · have := h.mem_nhds (left_mem_Ico.2 hab)

    have := this.1

  · have hcl := h.closure_eq
    have hb : b ∈ closure (Ico a b) := by

exact @key (-1) (1) ((by norm_num))'),
